workspace_intro: Pick the repositories Cleared works on, among those your GitHub token reaches. Cleared clones them, reads their code, and proposes how they fit together: the services, their contracts and the calls between them. Nothing is written until you tick it.
workspace_none: Your token reaches no repository yet.
workspace_tick_hint: Tick what is right: only the ticked lines are written.
workspace_layout_manifests: {repo} has folders with a project of their own
workspace_layout_whole: The whole repository as one service
workspace_contracts_none: No contract file under a known name, such as contract/openapi.yaml.
workspace_links_none: No call between these services was found. A call is read against the other service's contract, so tick its contract line if it has one, or add the link later.
workspace_written: The workspace is written with {services}. Links ticked: {links}. Contracts ticked: {contracts}. Cleared uses it from its next start.
workspace_problem_no_forge: Connect GitHub first: the list comes from your token.
workspace_problem_unreachable: GitHub did not give the list. Check this machine's network and the token, then try again.
workspace_environment: The workspace comes from the CLEARED_V2_WORKSPACE variable of Cleared's environment. Change it there.
workspace_error_invalid: The request was not understood. Reload the page and pick again.
workspace_error_too_many: Pick 10 repositories at most at a time.
workspace_error_unknown_repository: A picked repository is no longer on your token's list. Reload the page.
workspace_error_changed: The proposal changed since this page read it. Clone and propose again.
workspace_error_cycle: The ticked calls go round in a circle. Untick one of them, so that the services can be released in order.
workspace_error_invalid_workspace: Cleared could not make a workspace it can read from these lines. Its log says why.
workspace_error_environment: The workspace comes from Cleared's environment: change CLEARED_V2_WORKSPACE there.
workspace_error_busy: A clone is already running. Wait for it to end.
workspace_error_checkout_other: A folder of this machine already holds another repository where this one would go. Its log names it.
workspace_error_unreachable: GitHub did not answer. Try again in a moment.
workspace_error_clone_failed: A repository could not be cloned or read. Cleared's log says why.
workspace_error_other: The step could not go on. Try again in a moment.
